verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents that its Computer agent includes a full cloud browser. It automatically launches browser sessions to interact with websites, fill forms, and reach login-gated pages, and also searches and browses for research. One hands-on community report says Computer sessions often fail to trigger or stall, which lowers confidence in reliability but does not show the browser capability is absent. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that browser tasks complete reliably, and detailed docs on supported website actions and user oversight in the consumer app.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: Computer includes a full cloud browser for tasks that go beyond search.
When a task requires interacting with a website, filling forms, or accessing login-gated content, Computer launches a browser session automatically.
Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages
